stories.title: Build NOSS compliance validator checking all 20 CoCu files for required structure
stories.description: Create Python script that validates all CoCu markdown files against NOSS requirements: bilingual headers, assessment criteria sections, learning outcome matrices, contact hour totals, employability skills, tools/equipment appendices, and references.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate_noss_compliance.py generated, takes content/ directory as input
outputs compliance_report.json with per-file results including section presence, header format, outcome split validation
exit code 0 for full compliance, 1 for any failures, exits 2 for file read errors

stories.title: Extract and validate 500+ English-Bahasa Malaysia key terms with spell check
stories.description: Parse all 20 CoCu files to build bilingual glossary, validate spelling using hunspell, flag inconsistent translations of same concept across files.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/extract_glossary.py generates glossary.json with English term, Bahasa Malaysia translation, category, source CoCu file
validates >=500 unique term pairs using hunspell for Bahasa Malaysia spelling
outputs terminology_inconsistencies.json flagging same concept with multiple BM translations

stories.title: Validate Knowledge/Performance outcome percentages across all work activities
stories.description: Ensure every work activity in all CoCu files has exactly 30% Knowledge and 70% Performance hours allocation per NOSS standard.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate_learning_outcomes.py reads all learning outcome matrices from content/ files
flags any activity with Knowledge != 30% or Performance != 70%, outputs violations.json with file:activity:actual_split
generates outcomes_distribution.html bar chart showing compliance rate per level

stories.title: Build interactive HTML compliance dashboard aggregating all NOSS quality metrics
stories.description: Single-page dashboard showing real-time compliance status across section completeness, equipment currency, outcome balance, bilingual coverage, and contact hours.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/generate_compliance_dashboard.py outputs dashboard.html with 5 metric cards: section completeness %, equipment currency %, learning outcome balance %, bilingual coverage %, contact hour accuracy %
dashboard includes drill-down tables showing per-file status with color-coded pass/fail indicators
dashboard is self-contained HTML (no external dependencies) with refresh button to recheck compliance

stories.title: Generate competency-based assessment rubrics for all work activities using 4-point Likert scale
stories.description: Auto-create assessment rubrics mapping each work activity to Novice/Developing/Proficient/Advanced descriptors aligned with Knowledge (30%) and Performance (70%) split.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/generate_assessment_rubrics.py parses learning outcomes from all CoCu files, outputs rubrics.json with activity_name, competency_code, proficiency_levels array [Novice, Developing, Proficient, Advanced], knowledge_descriptor, performance_descriptor
each rubric includes sample evidence collection indicators for assessor guidance
rubrics.json integrates with learning_outcome_matrices from existing content

stories.title: Create L3→L4→L5 skill progression validator ensuring prerequisites and content sequencing
stories.description: Map competencies across levels to verify L4 activities build on L3 foundations and L5 adds management/strategic layer without orphaned skills.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate_level_progression.py reads work activities from all three levels, outputs progression_map.json showing competency chains and L3→L4→L5 coverage
flags missing prerequisites where L4/L5 reference L3 concepts not present, outputs progression_issues.json
generates level_progression.html visualization of skill stacks

stories.title: Audit equipment and technology currency against 2024-2026 industry support status
stories.description: Cross-check all tools/equipment listed in CoCu appendices against current market support, flag EOL or obsolete items requiring content update.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/audit_equipment_currency.py reads tools/equipment tables from all content/ files, outputs equipment_currency_report.json with item_name, current_status (supported/eol/deprecated), market_relevance_year, replacement_recommendation
flags any equipment with EOL before 2026, outputs deprecation_warnings.json
includes CLI: scripts/audit_equipment_currency.py --check-online to validate against public support databases

stories.title: Implement Bahasa Malaysia terminology consistency validator across all 20 CoCu files
stories.description: Build index of all Bahasa Malaysia terms and flag inconsistent translations where same concept uses different BM terms across files.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/validate_terminology_consistency.py scans all content/ CoCu files, builds term_index.json mapping English concepts to Bahasa Malaysia translations with file:location entries
outputs terminology_variance.json listing concepts with >1 BM translation variant, suggests standardized term
provides fix script: scripts/standardize_terminology.py --apply to auto-correct variants to chosen standard

stories.title: Create contact hour justification document explaining pedagogical rationale for hour allocations
stories.description: Generate PDF document with workload analysis, benchmark comparisons, and skill complexity justification for each CoCu contact hour assignment across L3/L4/L5.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/generate_contact_hour_justification.py outputs contact_hour_justification.pdf with sections: L3 workload analysis (1200hrs breakdown), L4/L5 benchmark comparisons vs industry standards, skill complexity matrix mapping activities to Bloom's levels and hours
PDF includes tables showing contact hour distribution per CoCu and justification narrative
requires python-docx and reportlab, generates audit trail for JPK submission

stories.title: Generate NOSS compliance metadata package for MySkills Portal JPK submission
stories.description: Bundle all compliance validation outputs, glossaries, rubrics, and quality reports into structured ZIP file with manifest for JPK/MySPIKE upload.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/package_compliance_metadata.py creates compliance_metadata_YYYYMMDD.zip containing: compliance_report.json, glossary.json, rubrics.json, progression_map.json, equipment_currency.json, terminology_index.json, contact_hour_justification.pdf, and manifest.json
manifest.json lists all included files with sha256 hashes and compliance_version field for audit trail
outputs manifest.json with file_count, total_cocus, total_activities, overall_compliance_score, generated_timestamp
